answers.why: Israel could boast that its own hand saved it from Midian.
Gideon sends the remaining Israelite soldiers to their tents.
Gideon is identified as a man belonging to Israel.
Gideon returns to Israel's military camp and addresses its soldiers.
Israel's men assemble from several tribes and pursue Midian.
Soldiers gather from Naphtali to pursue Midian.
Soldiers gather from Asher to pursue Midian.
Soldiers gather from all Manasseh to pursue Midian.
Ephraim's men assemble and seize the waters and Jordan.
Ephraim's men complain that Gideon did not summon them to battle.
Ephraim's gleanings represent the tribe's capture of Midian's princes.
Israel's men ask Gideon to rule over them after their deliverance.
All Israel goes after the ephod Gideon placed in Ophrah.
Israel is the people to whom Gideon showed goodness through his deliverance.
